India continue their winning run!
The Indian men's hockey team registered a commanding 5-2 victory over China at the Asian Champions Trophy in Jalandhar.
Harmanpreet Singh and Sukhjeet Singh scored a brace each, while Jugraj Singh chipped in with a goal to seal a comprehensive win for India!
